title: Объясни Ситуацию (Речь)
description: Представь, что ты менеджер проекта. Расскажи, что будет готово к завтрашнему дню. Используй Future Perfect.
topic: Представь, что ты менеджер проекта. Расскажи, что будет готово к завтрашнему дню. Используй Future Perfect.

conditions.label: Результат к моменту (will have + V3)
conditions.hint: By 5 PM tomorrow, we will have signed the contract.

conditions.label: Маркер времени BY
conditions.hint: We will have started the campaign by 5 p.m. / He will have left the office by noon. / They will have built the new school by next year. / She will have saved enough money by December. / I will have finished my homework by bedtime.

script.description: Примеры (результат к моменту — will have + V3):
sentences: By 5 p.m. tomorrow, we will have signed the contract.
By next week, they will have finished the project.
By the end of the month, she will have passed all her exams.
By Monday morning, I will have read the whole book.
By the time you arrive, we will have prepared everything.
